title: Treat kernel headers as part of the 4.0.4 base system
author: ryanrhughes
body:
Backport the base-system kernel-header guarantee to 4.0.4. The ISO always installs the selected kernel's headers, so hardware and Xbox installers only install their drivers.

A small migration repairs headers omitted by earlier fresh installs, including linux-omarchy and linux-t2 systems. Acceptance tests check the running kernel and matching headers. The Cam Link feature remains absent from this release branch.

Validation: migration fixtures pass for both kernel families, multiple kernels, idempotence, unrelated kernels, and package-install failure. A fresh ISO built from this branch at 8f3ab025 and omacom/omarchy-iso#184 passed installation, reboot, and the full KVM acceptance suite (88s). The guest has linux-omarchy and linux-omarchy-headers 7.2.5-3, with release 7.2.5-3-omarchy and no stock linux/linux-headers. Installed migration and NVIDIA script hashes match this source, and the removed selector is absent.

Upstream runtime: #11900. ISO guarantee: omacom/omarchy-iso#184. Package dependency cleanup: omacom/omarchy-pkgs#454. The corrected packages and runtime need publication before building the next release ISO.
